title: Digital Marketer cum Trainer  Malayalam
description:
**Company Description** 
 Judah Code Technologies is an IT company focused on delivering technology\-driven solutions and services to a diverse range of clients. The organization values innovation, practical problem\-solving, and continuous learning. Team members collaborate on software and digital projects that support business growth and digital transformation. The company fosters a professional environment where technical expertise and customer\-centric approaches are encouraged. Judah Code Technologies offers opportunities for skill development and career advancement in the technology and digital space.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Digital Marketer cum Trainer (Malayalam) role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Coimbatore. The role involves planning, executing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns across social media and other online channels, with a focus on the Malayalam\-speaking audience. Day\-to\-day tasks include creating and managing content, monitoring web analytics, generating and nurturing leads, and supporting overall marketing initiatives. In addition, the role requires designing and delivering training sessions in Malayalam on digital marketing concepts, tools, and best practices for learners or internal teams. The Digital Marketer cum Trainer will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure marketing goals and training objectives are met effectively.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to plan and execute Digital Marketing campaigns, including Marketing strategy development and implementation.
* Skills in Social Media Marketing for audience engagement and brand promotion across relevant platforms.
* Experience in Lead Generation using digital channels to attract, qualify, and convert prospects.
* Proficiency in Web Analytics tools to track performance, interpret data, and optimize campaigns.
* Strong fluency in Malayalam and English, with the ability to train and present clearly in Malayalam.
* Prior experience as a digital marketing trainer or educator is advantageous.
* Good communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work in a team environment.
* Relevant academic background in Marketing, Communications, IT, or a related field is preferred.

title: Content Creator & Creative Editor
description:
**Content Creator \& Creative Editor** 




  





 We're looking for a hands\-on Content Creator \& Creative Editor who can take an idea from concept to finished piece. You'll plan, shoot, write, and edit content that tells our brand story across social media, the website, email, and campaigns. You'll be the person who keeps our visual and written voice sharp, consistent, and engaging.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Content creation** 



* Conceptualise and produce short\-form videos, reels, photos, carousels, and static posts for social channels
* Write clear, engaging copy for social captions, blogs, website pages, email newsletters, and product descriptions
* Build monthly content calendars aligned with marketing goals, launches, and seasonal campaigns
* Shoot product and lifestyle content, including basic direction of shoots, props, and locations
* Track trends and formats, and adapt them to suit the brand



**Creative editing** 



* Edit videos end to end: cuts, transitions, colour correction, sound, captions, and motion graphics
* Retouch and edit photographs and design marketing creatives such as banners, thumbnails, and ads
* Review and edit content from other team members for tone, clarity, grammar, and brand consistency
* Maintain brand guidelines for visuals, tone of voice, and formatting
* Adapt one piece of content into multiple formats and platforms



**Performance and collaboration** 



* Work with sales, design, and leadership teams to turn briefs into creative output
* Monitor content performance (reach, engagement, watch time, conversions) and use insights to improve
* Organise and archive the content asset library
* Coordinate with freelancers, agencies, and photographers where needed



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Design, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Strong portfolio showing video, photo, and written work
* Proficiency in editing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut
* Working knowledge of Canva or Figma
* Excellent written English (additional languages are a plus)
* Solid grasp of Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other social platform formats and algorithms
* Basic understanding of lighting, framing, and audio for shoots
* Strong eye for detail, storytelling, and aesthetics



**Good to Have** 



* Experience with product, lifestyle, or D2C brand content
* Basic SEO and analytics knowledge
* Motion graphics or animation skills
* Own camera, lighting, or editing setup
* Experience with AI\-assisted creative tools



**What Makes You a Great Fit** 



* You're a storyteller who can pitch ideas, not just execute briefs
* You balance creativity with deadlines and brand consistency
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly
* You're comfortable wearing multiple hats in a fast\-paced, small\-team environment



**What We Offer** 



* Creative freedom and ownership of the brand's content voice
* Opportunity to grow into a content lead or creative head role



**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume and portfolio (links to videos, designs, and writing samples) to swathi@naatscorp.com with the subject line
 **"Content Creator \& Creative Editor – \[Your Name]"** 
 .

title: General Practitioner
description:
**Company Description** 
 Paresha HR Services Private Limited, founded in 2018, is a trusted partner in end\-to\-end Human Resources Management solutions. The organization is led by experienced HR subject matter experts with diverse industry backgrounds and a strong understanding of business operations. Paresha offers comprehensive services including HR policies, payroll management, statutory compliance, automation, and performance management systems. The company is committed to delivering high\-quality, tailored solutions that help client organizations optimize their workforce and achieve strategic goals. Joining Paresha means contributing to impactful HR initiatives that support organizational growth and employee development.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site General Practitioner role based in Coimbatore North. The General Practitioner will provide primary medical care, including patient consultations, physical examinations, diagnosis, and treatment for a broad range of conditions. Responsibilities include managing outpatient care, prescribing medications, maintaining accurate medical records, and coordinating with nursing and allied health staff to ensure continuity of care. The role also involves health education, preventive care, and promoting wellness through regular check\-ups and counseling. The General Practitioner may support clinical training activities, adhere to clinical protocols and regulatory requirements, and collaborate with management to improve patient services and care standards.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Medicine and Primary Care, with the ability to diagnose and manage common acute and chronic conditions.
* Experience or training in Family Medicine, with a focus on holistic, long\-term patient care across age groups.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Nursing and other clinical staff to deliver safe, coordinated patient care.
* Competence in Training activities, such as mentoring junior clinicians or supporting health education programs.
* Recognized medical degree (MBBS or equivalent) and valid registration with the appropriate medical council.
* Prior experience as a General Practitioner or in a similar clinical role, preferably in a primary care or family medicine setting.
* Strong clinical decision\-making skills, attention to detail, and commitment to evidence\-based practice.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with a patient\-centered and culturally sensitive approach.
* Ability to work on\-site full time in Coimbatore North and adhere to organizational policies and clinical protocols.

title: L2 Support Engineer - Managed Services
description:
Role Summary
   

  

 The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End\-to\-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3\-tier and cloud\-native environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.
* Configure and fine\-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.
* Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.
* Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third\-party dependency, in both 3\-tier and cloud\-native (microservices/containerized) environments.
* Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.
* Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.
* Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.
* Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto\-remediation triggers, ticket auto\-creation).
* Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.
* Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).
* Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.
* Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Observability Platform Skills
   

  

* 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1\-2 years working hands\-on with Datadog.
* Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service\-level troubleshooting.
* Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).
* APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.
* Synthetics: designing multi\-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.
* RUM: correlating front\-end performance and errors with backend traces.
* Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log\-based metrics.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.
* Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.


 Application and Architecture Understanding
   

  

* Solid understanding of 3\-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter\-service communication patterns.
* Ability to correlate application\-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.
* Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).
* Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.
* Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.
* Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.
* Comfortable leading discussions during high\-pressure major incidents.
* Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


 Work Details
   

  

* Level: L2 (Mid\-level, Managed Services)
* Shift: 24x7 rotational shifts, with on\-call/escalation coverage as needed
* Reporting To: L3 Engineer / Observability Team Lead


 Interested can reach us at \+91 7305206696/ saranyadevib@talentien.com

**Role Summary / Description**

 As a hands\-on Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture, you will design, build, automate, monitor and optimize AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure for reliable, scalable and cost\-effective model development and production workloads. You will work on moderately complex infrastructure components under guidance from senior architects and engineers, contributing to GPU/accelerated compute environments, model deployment pipelines, observability, security and operational reliability for AI\-driven business solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Write, review and debug code, scripts and infrastructure\-as\-code for Azure AI infrastructure, automation, monitoring and deployment tooling.
   

  

 Configure and provision Azure compute resources for AI/ML workloads, including Azure VMs, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Machine Learning compute, Azure Storage and supporting networking/security services.
   

  

 Support deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines for AI systems, models and applications using tools such as Git, Bicep/ARM/Terraform, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes and workflow orchestration tooling.
   

  

 Deploy and operate AI services, model\-serving components and data pipelines while applying reliability, security, cost\-efficiency and scalability practices.
   

  

 Monitor infrastructure and model\-serving health using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and related observability tools troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, networking, containers and application layers.
   

  

 Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, platform engineers and architects to integrate AI models into enterprise systems while meeting compliance and operational requirements.
   

  

 Document reusable patterns, configuration standards and runbooks for Azure\-based AI infrastructure.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience coding, building, monitoring or troubleshooting AI/ML infrastructure, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or cloud/platform engineering solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the compute, storage, networking, security and deployment foundations required to run AI workloads.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, Bash or PowerShell.
   

  

 Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, containers, Kubernetes, workflow orchestration and operational monitoring tools.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving ability, communication skills and collaboration mindset in a fast\-paced engineering environment.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Hands\-on experience with Azure services relevant to AI infrastructure such as Azure VMs, AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Storage, Azure Virtual Network, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
   

  

 Experience designing or operating GPU/accelerated compute, distributed training setups, containerized deployments and model\-serving workloads.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Bicep/ARM/Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and observability practices.
   

  

 Ability to optimize infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, cost and security.
   

  

 Understanding of MLOps patterns including experiment tracking, model registry, model deployment, monitoring and rollback approaches.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 Azure certification such as Azure Administrator, Azure Developer, Azure Solutions Architect, Azure AI Engineer or Azure Data Engineer.

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical Senior Media Analyst to join our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) team at Meltwater. The ideal candidate will also have experience in company research, content strategy, and quality assurance, with the ability to independently own workflows and guide junior analysts. The ideal candidate will have a strong command of language, keen attention to detail, and the ability to interpret and categorize complex content effectively.

* Monitor branch vacancies.
* Ensure critical roles are filled before branch launch.
* Monitor early attrition.

* Code of Conduct

* Employee grievances

* Poor performance
* Misconduct
* Disciplinary matters
* Employee complaints

 Work with Compliance, Risk, Audit and Legal in cases involving fraud, cash irregularities, document manipulation, data misuse, bribery, conflict of interest and serious misconduct.

* Build functional leadership pipelines.
* Promote internal career progression.
* Maintain succession plans for critical positions.

* Role\-wise attrition
* Early attrition
* High\-performer attrition



 Conduct exit interviews and initiate corrective actions based on trends.

* Gratuity
* Bonus
* Maternity benefits
* Leave requirements
* Shops and Establishments requirements
* POSH

 Coordinate with Legal or external consultants where required.

* Performance Management
* Incentives
* Code of Conduct
* Disciplinary Action
* Travel and Reimbursements

* Attendance

* Performance management
* Training
* Document management
* Employee self\-service
* HR analytics
* Approval workflows

* Headcount

* Attrition
* Payroll and manpower cost
* Branch productivity
* Employee tenure
* Training completion
* Performance ratings

 Use HR data to support manpower and people decisions.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Summary:** 




 This role is the primary point of contact for IT support within the organization, helping employees resolve laptop issues, account access problems, software installations, and everyday technical queries. It is an ideal opportunity to build a strong IT foundation while being guided and mentored by an experienced senior team.
 



  





**Position Overview:** 




 The “System Administrator” is responsible for maintaining smooth day\-to\-day IT operations across the organization. This role covers end\-user support, asset management, system upkeep, and vendor coordination, making it a well\-rounded position for someone looking to grow within an IT support function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Provide day\-to\-day support to employees on tickets, laptops, logins, printers, software installations, and related requests.
* Complete daily preventive checks across the office — verifying that IT hardware, servers, UPS, and internet links are up, both physically and logically — and act on any deviation.
* Build and deliver new laptops end to end: imaging, domain join, host ID and AD account creation, project\-specific software, endpoint agent installation, asset tagging, and user handover.
* Maintain the asset register and host ID records accurately, and provision test PCs and virtual machines against validated user requirements, tracking usage duration and reclaiming resources on expiry.
* Manage the user account lifecycle — email IDs, AD accounts, distribution lists and group memberships, password resets, and access provisioning and revocation during onboarding and exit.
* Test and deploy Windows and third\-party patches through the endpoint management console, monitor patch non\-compliance reports, and resolve the root cause of failures.
* Maintain endpoint security compliance: monitor antivirus and endpoint protection consoles, bring non\-compliant systems back into compliance, respond to threat and data\-loss\-prevention alerts, and validate license terms for software approval requests.
* Run scheduled backups of servers, Active Directory, and databases to the NAS, and perform periodic restore checks with project teams to confirm data integrity.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware, software, and facility requirements — obtaining and comparing quotes, securing approvals, releasing purchase orders, and following up until delivery and installation.
* Support network and infrastructure monitoring, including Wi\-Fi and LAN authentication, firewall and CCTV checks, and report anomalies to the senior team.
* Keep trackers, checklists, and basic documentation current to support ISO audits, knowledge sharing, and team organisation.
* Escalate recurring or complex issues to the Team Lead or Senior System Administrator for permanent resolution.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Diploma, BCA, B.Sc., or B.E. (Postgraduate candidates will not be considered.)
* Proficient with Windows, Outlook, and standard office productivity software.
* Basic understanding of networks, Wi\-Fi, and general office IT infrastructure.
* Some familiarity with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
* 1–5 years of hands\-on IT support or system administration experience.
* A helpful and patient approach to working directly with end\-users.
* Willingness to learn new tools and adapt quickly in a dynamic environment.



  





**Benefits:** 



* We want every Soliton member to grow to their highest potential. Our work environment helps individuals explore their interests and potential and reach out to the resources and people available at Soliton to realize them. Read more about what it’s like to work at Soliton. Soliton Employee Value Proposition.
* Solitons choose their work hours as long as it takes into account the requirements of the job. We take special care to support mothers to excel at work while they handle their responsibilities at home.
* At Soliton, we believe that every team member contributes to our success and revenue, directly or indirectly. To recognize this, we share a portion of our profits with all Solitons. Starting from your second year with us, you’ll be eligible to receive a share of the company’s profits.
* Health insurance for employees and families, gym and cycle allowance – your health is a priority!



  





**About Soliton:** 




 Soliton Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a high\-technology software company headquartered in Bangalore, India.
 



 Soliton works with global companies, from start\-ups to Fortune 500, across industries including Semiconductors, Medical Devices, Automotive, Industry 4\.0, and Robotics to help them increase their competitiveness and release great products through Software Engineering Services. Since 1997, we have been growing over 25% annually because we especially focus on raising our standards constantly, to deliver an excellent experience to both our customers and our employees.
 



 Soliton Technologies is a certified Great Place to Work® in the Mid\-Sized Organizations Category, recognized and issued by the Great Place to Work® Institute. This certification is a testament to our focus on our values of Respect, Integrity, Excellence and Innovation.
 



 With a team of over 400 employees across the world, we forge ahead as engineers working to our heart’s content, moving humanity forward.
 



  





**Additional Details:** 



* Work Location (Bangalore/Coimbatore): This role will require working from the office (WFO).
* For more information, visit https://www.solitontech.com/and do read the Impact Report to get a glimpse of the first 25 years of our truly meaningful journey.

External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.

Responsible for ensuring the quality of sheet metal fabricated and welded components by monitoring production processes, conducting inspections, identifying defects, and implementing corrective and preventive actions.

* Develop, implement, and maintain incoming quality control procedures, inspection plans, and quality standards.
* Train, guide, and supervise quality inspectors to ensure consistent inspection practices and compliance with quality requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of inspection reports, non\-conformance reports (NCRs), supplier quality performance, and quality metrics.
* Conduct internal audits and supplier quality assessments to ensure compliance with established procedures and standards.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Good understanding of engineering drawings, GD\&T, material specifications, and customer technical requirements.
* Experience in supplier quality management, incoming inspection, and quality documentation review.

 Global Hearing Aid Centre is a consumer services company specializing in hearing care solutions, currently operating in Tamil Nadu, India. The organization focuses on providing diagnostic hearing services and hearing aid fittings for individuals with hearing and communication challenges. Team members work closely with clients to improve overall hearing health and quality of life through personalized care. The company values professionalism, ethical practice, and a client\-centered approach in all services offered.
 



**Role Description** 
 This full\-time on\-site Clinical Audiologist role is based in Chennai and involves providing comprehensive audiological services to clients of varied ages. Daily responsibilities include conducting hearing assessments, interpreting test results, and recommending appropriate treatment plans and hearing solutions. The Clinical Audiologist will perform hearing aid selection, fitting, programming, and follow\-up care, while maintaining accurate clinical records and documentation. The role also includes aural rehabilitation services, counseling clients and families on hearing health, and collaborating with other professionals to support speech and communication outcomes. The clinician is expected to follow evidence\-based practices, uphold regulatory standards, and contribute to continuous improvement of clinic processes and patient experience.

* Ability to communicate clearly and empathetically with clients and families, with strong documentation and organizational skills.

* Prior experience in a hearing care clinic or hospital setting is an advantage.

title: Senior Meta Ads Manager
description:
Concept Marketing is a Perth\-based digital marketing agency with 25\+ years of experience working across a broad range of Australian and international clients. We are looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager to join our offshore team, working closely with our Australian head office to plan, build, manage, and report on Meta advertising campaigns across the full client portfolio.
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on role. You will own Meta delivery from strategy through to execution. You will be expected to work independently, communicate clearly, diagnose problems across the full funnel, and apply instructions without needing them repeated.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



 Campaign Strategy and Architecture
 


* Build, launch, and optimise Meta ad campaigns across Facebook and Instagram for multiple clients simultaneously
* Structure campaigns correctly from the ground up, including objectives, ad sets, audiences, placements, budgets, and bidding strategies
* Know when to consolidate campaigns versus segment them, and understand how Meta's auction and delivery system responds to structural decisions
* Use campaign budget optimisation versus ad set budget optimisation strategically, not by default
* Manage ad fatigue cycles and rotate creative proactively before performance drops
* Manage frequency intentionally across funnel stages
* Run all campaign types including lead generation, conversion, awareness, retargeting, and traffic



  





**Audience and Signal Strategy** 



* Build and maintain a clean, organised custom audience library across all client accounts
* Develop full\-funnel audience strategy including custom audiences, lookalikes, retargeting segments, and exclusion logic
* Understand audience overlap and apply exclusion logic correctly
* Use value\-based lookalikes where purchase or lead quality data exists
* Know when broad targeting with strong creative outperforms narrow audience targeting, and test accordingly
* Understand Advantage\+ audiences and when to use or constrain them



  





**Tracking, Technical Setup, and Data Integrity** 



* Implement and verify the Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and custom events
* Configure Aggregated Event Measurement correctly post\-iOS 14
* Set up GA4 goals and conversion tracking and connect these to campaign reporting
* Maintain accurate and consistent UTM structures across all campaigns
* Troubleshoot tracking issues independently before escalating
* Understand the differences between Meta\-reported data, GA4 data, and actual CRM or backend conversions, and be able to explain the gap clearly
* Set up and interpret Meta Attribution Settings correctly based on business type and sales cycle
* Know the limitations of iOS 14\+ signal loss and apply practical responses including first\-party data strategy
* Identify when data is unreliable and flag it rather than report it as fact



  





**Ad Creative** 



* Brief designers and copywriters with enough specificity that the output is usable without rework
* Write ad copy that is direct, on\-brand, and built to convert
* Read creative performance data and identify whether an issue is the hook, the body, the CTA, the format, or the audience mismatch
* Understand the difference between a scroll\-stop problem and a conversion problem
* Structure creative testing with a clear hypothesis, not random variation
* Review creative performance and feed learnings back into briefing



  





**Problem Solving and Diagnosis** 



* Diagnose performance issues across the full funnel, from impression through to conversion, before escalating or reporting a problem
* Review landing pages before campaigns go live and flag conversion issues proactively
* Understand that a low conversion rate is not always a media problem and communicate clearly to the relevant team what needs to change and why
* Read client performance in the context of the business, not just the platform
* Factor in seasonality, sales cycles, and external variables when interpreting results
* Do not over\-claim credit for results or under\-explain causes of decline
* Surface issues early with context and a recommended next step, not just a notification that something is wrong



  





**Reporting** 



* Prepare clear, accurate performance reports for the Australian team on a regular cadence
* Report against agreed KPIs including cost per lead, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and spend efficiency
* Present data with interpretation, not just numbers
* Flag anomalies and performance shifts proactively, not reactively



  





**Staying Current** 



* Keep up with Meta platform changes, new ad formats, and algorithm updates as they happen
* Test new features including Advantage\+, Advantage\+ creative, and AI\-driven tools with intent, not just because they are available
* Understand where Meta's automated tools perform well and where they need to be constrained or overridden



  





**Account Hygiene and Documentation**

title: Consultant / Scientist: Molecular and Diagnostic Microbiology
description:
**P. Namperumalsamy Regional Research Center (PNRRC), Aravind Eye Hospital, Coimbatore** 




  




* **Qualification: MD (Microbiology) or PhD (Microbiology).**
* **Experience: Hands\-on experience in a diagnostic microbiology laboratory is essential. Appointment: Full\-time.**
* **Designation (Consultant or Scientist) will depend on qualification and experience**
* **Salary: Commensurate with qualification and experience**



  





**The role** 



* Aravind Eye Hospital, Coimbatore, is looking for a microbiologist to lead its Molecular and Diagnostic Microbiology program at PNRRC. The position carries full responsibility for the diagnostic microbiology laboratory and for the molecular diagnostics research program.



**Diagnostic service** 



* Run the diagnostic microbiology laboratory serving a high\-volume tertiary eye hospital: microbial keratitis, endophthalmitis and ocular surface infections
* Maintain quality standards, standard operating procedures and turnaround times, and lead the laboratory towards accreditation
* Work closely with the cornea, retina and other clinical teams on result interpretation and difficult cases



**Molecular diagnostics** 



* Lead the molecular diagnostics program, which currently includes CRISPR/Cas12a\-based rapid pan\-fungal detection, PCR\-based pathogen identification and metagenomic sequencing on an in\-house Nanopore platform
* Take assays from development through optimization, analytical validation and clinical validation, and into routine use where warranted
* Contribute to the design and conduct of the ICMR\-funded multicentre program on molecular diagnosis of fungal endophthalmitis, and related work on infectious keratitis



**Research and training** 



* Design, conduct and publish studies drawing on the hospital's large clinical specimen base
* Contribute to grant applications and external collaborations
* Supervise technical staff and postgraduate trainees



**Essential** 



* MD (Microbiology) or PhD (Microbiology)
* Experience running, or working at a senior level in, a routine diagnostic microbiology laboratory
* Working knowledge of laboratory quality systems
* Ability to function as part of a clinical service and communicate with clinicians
* Demonstrated interest in research (publications, projects or grants)



**Desirable** 



* Molecular diagnostic assay development and validation
* PCR, sequencing (including Nanopore metagenomics)



**What Aravind offers** 



* A high\-volume tertiary eye hospital: the laboratory receives approximately 1000 ocular specimens a year
* An established molecular laboratory with real\-time PCR, a Nanopore sequencer, etc. and a team of 6 technical staff
* An ICMR\-funded multicentre program in molecular diagnostics for endophthalmitis, with assay validation and metagenomic sequencing under way
* Daily working contact between clinicians and researchers, and a research group with a record of publication in ocular infection and molecular diagnostics
* Support for research proposals, conference presentation and postgraduate supervision
* How to apply
* Send the following to siddharth@aravind.org with the subject line "Application: Molecular and Diagnostic Microbiology":
* Curriculum vitae, including a list of publications
* A one\-page statement of research interests and relevant diagnostic laboratory experience
* Names and contact details of two referees

 The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. title: Fabrication & Production supervisor
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Production Supervisor leads day\-to\-day operations within the fabrication shop and final packaging area, ensuring safe, efficient, high\-quality production that meets customer delivery commitments. This role is responsible for supervising shop\-floor personnel, coordinating production activities across work centers, managing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement through Lean and operational\-excellence practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise fabrication shop and final packaging operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and on\-time delivery targets.
* Plan, prioritize, and schedule production activities across multiple work centers based on workload, capacity, material availability, and delivery commitments.
* Assign daily work to shop employees according to skill level, certifications, workload, and production priorities.
* Maintain and regularly update the shop\-floor skill matrix; identify training needs and coordinate employee development activities.
* Ensure compliance with Flowserve safety policies, safe work practices, and applicable environmental requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by conducting regular safety discussions, identifying risks, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure production processes comply with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements, including adherence to documentation, traceability, inspection, and record\-retention procedures.
* Monitor and manage key operational KPIs, including utilization, efficiency, productivity, scrap, rework, quality performance, and schedule adherence.
* Analyze production losses, quality issues, and daily shop\-floor constraints; implement corrective and preventive actions using structured problem\-solving tools.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives, including AMEF/FMEA, Value Stream Mapping, 5S/6S, SMED, standard work, visual management, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Apply statistical process\-control principles to monitor process performance, identify variation, and improve product quality.
* Support inventory management activities, including material availability, WIP control, inventory accuracy, and coordination with planning and supply chain teams.
* Ensure appropriate use of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, and other production\-planning tools for reporting, scheduling, and daily operational management.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, manufacturing procedures, inspection plans, and customer specifications.
* Ensure fabrication and assembly activities comply with applicable engineering and industry standards, including API 610, ASME, AWS, and other relevant requirements.
* Support and oversee API and non\-API pump manufacturing processes, ensuring that approved procedures and quality requirements are consistently followed.
* Conduct training for shop employees on safety, quality, procedures, technical requirements, Lean practices, and standard work.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, and Maintenance teams to resolve operational issues and improve overall plant performance.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including experience supervising shop\-floor operations.
* Demonstrated experience in fabrication shop operations and final packaging activities.
* Working knowledge of CNC programming and machining/manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous\-improvement tools, including AMEF/FMEA, VSM, 5S/6S, SMED, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with production planning, capacity management, work\-center scheduling, and inventory/WIP management.

title: Retail store Manager
description:
Job Title
 



 Store Manager
 



 Location Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 



 Reports To Retail Head / Operations Head
 



  





 Role Purpose
 



 Own the store’s P\&L and customer experience. Drive sales, manage inventory and costs, lead the store team, and ensure Kitser’s brand standards in merchandising, service, and operations. 
 



  
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 1\. Sales \& Business Growth
 



 Achieve monthly sales, margin, and Category targets for Retail Division
 



 Plan and execute store\-level promotions, festive offers, and local marketing activations with the marketing team. 
 



 Monitor daily/weekly sales dashboards; take corrective actions on slow categories and SKUs. 
 



 Track key retail KPIs: conversion rate, average transaction value (ATV), items per customer (IPC), and footfall\-to\-sale. 
 



 2\. Customer Experience
 



 • Ensure a high\-quality in\-store experience: greeting, needs assessment, product demos, and post\-sale follow\-up. 
 



 • Resolve complaints and escalations quickly; maintain high CSAT/NPS. 
 



 3\. Inventory \& Stock Management
 



 • Maintain optimal stock levels across categories; minimize stockouts and overstock. 
 



 • Ensure accurate inventory records, cycle counts, and shrinkage control (theft/damage/errors). 
 



 • Coordinate with vendors/warehouses and Category Managers for timely replenishment and new launches. 
 



 4\. Visual Merchandising \& Store Standards
 



 • Implement brand\-compliant displays, signage, and product placement; keep the store clean and presentable. 
 



 • Execute seasonal/festive decor and POSM as per marketing calendars. 
 



 • Ensure safety, security, and compliance with store SOPs and local regulations. 
 



 5\. Team Leadership \& HR
 



 • Hire, train, schedule, and supervise sales associates, and support staff. 
 



 • Conduct performance reviews, coaching, and incentive tracking against KPIs. 
 



 • Maintain attendance, leave, and discipline records; create a positive, high\-performance culture. 
 



 6\. Operations, Finance \& Reporting
 



 • Manage daily cash/POS reconciliation and cash transfers as per finance policy. 
 



 • Control operating expenses (staffing, utilities, supplies) to protect store profitability. 
 



 • Prepare and submit weekly/monthly reports: sales vs target, inventory, shrinkage, expenses, and action plans. 
 



  
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 • Sales achievement (% to target), gross margin %, and category mix. 
 



 • Conversion rate, ATV, IPC, and footfall utilization. 
 



 • Inventory accuracy and shrinkage rate. 
 



 • Customer satisfaction/complaint resolution time. 
 



 • Staff productivity, attendance, and training completion. 
 



 • Cost control vs budget (OPEX). 
 



  
 



 Qualifications \& Experience
 



 • Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PG in Retail/Operations is a plus. 
 



 • 8 \-10 years of retail/store management experience; consumer durables, or home improvement preferred. 
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience with POS systems, Excel/Google Sheets, and basic reporting. 
 



  
 



 Skills \& Competencies
 



 • Sales leadership, negotiation, and customer handling. 
 



 • Inventory and vendor coordination. 
 



 • Visual merchandising sense and brand compliance. 
 



 • People management, coaching, and conflict resolution. 
 



 • Data\-driven decision\-making and problem\-solving. 
 



  
 



 Working Conditions
 



 • Full\-time role with rotating shifts/week off as per retail roster. 
 


* • Frequent floor time; occasional travel for training/vendor meetings.
